frozen_before_scoring_statement: The radical SAM set was selected using only UniProt source metadata and prior-pool exclusions before deterministic sequence-neighbor diagnostics or terminal decisions were computed.

selection_rules: reviewed UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot rows from radical SAM source query with PDB cross-reference
require catalytic-activity annotation, sequence, active-site or binding-site annotation, and at least one PDB xref
require radical SAM or SAM/Fe-S source context before outcome scoring
exclude imported hard negatives and previously used prospective external candidate accessions
exclude cobalamin/coenzyme-B12/adenosylcobalamin overlap contexts from this radical SAM lane freeze
cap at two rows per primary EC number
do not use fingerprint scores, sequence-neighbor outcomes, Foldseek, ESM, or ePK evidence for selection
